concerns.text: FR-023 cross-references FR-014 ('See FR-014'), but FR-014 defines the requirements for `edge_spectrum.json`, whereas FR-023 concerns the generation of `similarity_matrix.json`.

Significant redundancy in functional requirements: FR-012, FR-017, and FR-019 all mandate URL verification and timestamp recording; FR-011 and FR-018 both enforce the `data/derived/` path; and FR-013 and FR-021 both mandate exercising JSON-schema contracts.
